tests.basis: No pair is promoted by lexical/model-label similarity; bounded clearance is zero.
Identity-safe non-DOI ancestors are retained with doi=null; no fabricated DOI is used.
Criterion explicitly treats NO_PATH_FOUND as non-evidence; nonpositive rows remain fail-closed.
No admission rule treats shared authorship alone as descent.
No admission rule uses experimental-domain overlap.
Citation absence is non-evidence under frozen Criterion v1.
W9 graph authority uses explicit source-attested edges only; no automatic transitive closure.
Criterion has BLOCKED_BY_EDITION_CONFLICT and W9 preserves prior edition/correction exceptions without silent normalization.
Synthetic pre-freeze case maps missing mandatory supplement to BLOCKED_BY_INCOMPLETE_SOURCE.
INT-03↔INT-06 remains SHARED_CONSTITUENT_ONLY with SHARED_FRAMEWORK subreason, not direct descent.
SHARED_FRAMEWORK/SHARED_CONSTITUENT/HISTORICAL_INSPIRATION do not generate direct edges transitively.
All explicit positive ancestry rows are blocked regardless of terminology.

destructive_test_execution: test_w9_fail_closed.py performs the required 28 invariants plus additional exactness checks; exact final GitHub Actions run is reported externally because a commit cannot self-contain the run created for itself.
